name: sub50
description: Real-time YouTube sync player with sub-50ms drift.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client,lan --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client" "node scripts/lan-banner.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
